{{Top|leg}}
'''Grab-safety''' technology was a type of shield developed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Used to counteract the effects of [[dovin basal]]s, most Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were equipped with an upgrade.
